### Configure environment. Load data.
```{r warning=F}

source(here::here("0-config.R"))

```


### Create aggregate means by district.
```{r map predictions v3}

# Load districts as sf
niger_adm2 <- st_read(dsn = paste0(shp_data,"ner_adm02_feb2018/NER_adm02_feb2018.shp")) %>%
  filter(adm_01 %in% c("Dosso","Tahoua")) #to remove Tahoua later

districts_sf <- niger_adm2
districts_sf <- st_make_valid(districts_sf)

#List of Dosso districts
Dosso_districts <- districts_sf$adm_02[districts_sf$adm_01=="Dosso"]

# Tibble of points
points_tibble_tx0 <- b_preds_mort_raster2_tx0_child
points_tibble_tx1 <- b_preds_mort_raster2_tx1_child
points_tibble_diff <- b_preds_mort_raster2_diff_child
points_tibble_probeff <- sims_mort_probeff_raster2

#Shape files
points_sf_tx0 <- st_as_sf(points_tibble_tx0, coords = c("x","y"), crs = st_crs(districts_sf))
points_sf_tx1 <- st_as_sf(points_tibble_tx1, coords = c("x","y"), crs = st_crs(districts_sf))
points_sf_diff <- st_as_sf(points_tibble_diff, coords = c("x","y"), crs = st_crs(districts_sf))
points_sf_probeff <- st_as_sf(points_tibble_probeff, coords = c("x","y"), crs = st_crs(districts_sf))

# Spatial join: assign each point to a district
points_joined_tx0 <- st_join(points_sf_tx0, districts_sf, join = st_within)
points_joined_tx1 <- st_join(points_sf_tx1, districts_sf, join = st_within)
points_joined_diff <- st_join(points_sf_diff, districts_sf, join = st_within)
points_joined_probeff <- st_join(points_sf_probeff, districts_sf, join = st_within)

# Aggregate mean per district
mean_per_district_tx0 <- as.data.frame(points_joined_tx0) %>%
  dplyr::select(-geometry) %>%
  group_by(adm_02) %>%   # replace with your district ID field
  summarise(mean_tx0 = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  dplyr::filter(adm_02 %in% Dosso_districts)

mean_per_district_tx1 <- as.data.frame(points_joined_tx1) %>%
  dplyr::select(-geometry) %>%
  group_by(adm_02) %>%   # replace with your district ID field
  summarise(mean_tx1 = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  dplyr::filter(adm_02 %in% Dosso_districts)

mean_per_district_diff <- as.data.frame(st_join(points_joined_tx1, 
                                                points_joined_tx0, 
                                                join = st_within)) %>%
  dplyr::select(-geometry) %>%
  rename(adm_02 = adm_02.x) %>%
  group_by(adm_02) %>%
  summarise(mean_ATE = mean(value.x, na.rm = TRUE) - 
              mean(value.y, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  dplyr::filter(adm_02 %in% Dosso_districts)

#Quick preview
mean_per_district_tx0; mean_per_district_tx1; mean_per_district_diff
plot(mean_per_district_tx0); plot(mean_per_district_tx1); plot(mean_per_district_diff)

#Join with aggregate means
districts_sf_aggregate <- districts_sf %>%
  dplyr::filter(adm_01=="Dosso") %>%
  left_join(mean_per_district_tx0, by=join_by('adm_02'=='adm_02')) %>%
  left_join(mean_per_district_tx1, by=join_by('adm_02'=='adm_02')) %>%
  left_join(mean_per_district_diff, by=join_by('adm_02'=='adm_02'))

```
